p.title: v60.00 a figure from the data the chat model was given stays in the sentence that uses it
p.symptom: On a current-sensitive question the answer lost every sentence that wrote PER, a return, a moving-average gap or RSI, although those figures were in the prompt's own data blocks; only the quote price counted as evidence (v59.99), so a judgement written with its number was still deleted.
p.root_cause: The publication filter checked figures only against typed evidence rows. The ticker, technical, screener and domain blocks reach the model as text and had no row.
p.fix: src/ai/response/publication.js reads the figures of the injected reference text (answerReferenceText: the system prompt before the instruction tail, without the earlier-conversation and reader-note blocks) and treats a figure written there as supported, for the plan path, the fallback path and the event rule; js/aio-chat.js passes that text to the pipeline. A figure that is nowhere in the material is removed as before.
p.violated_rule: Owner decision 2026-11-12: a current figure is checked against what the model was given, not deleted because it is a figure.
p.prevention: ci-ai-intelligence-contract-check: five sentences with injected figures stay; a figure not in the data, one only in the earlier-conversation block and one only in the instruction tail are removed; without reference text behaviour is unchanged; the fallback path follows the same rule.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-ai-intelligence-contract-check.mjs exits 0; pipeline-semantics, chat-reliability, boot budget and the ratchets exit 0.

changelog: **Answers keep the figures they were given ({P}):** PER, returns, moving-average gaps and other figures from the chat's injected data now stay in the sentences that use them; invented figures are still removed.
note: v60.00: chat figures are checked against the injected data
